Staff Nurse Selected List
Wednesday, 29 May 2024
3841 Hits
We had published an advertisement for the Post of staff nurses.  Total post 11 were advertised (1- ST, 1- SBC, 2-VJNT, 5 – EWS, 2- Open). The last date of application submission was on 2
nd
May, 2024.  Total 352 applications were received and scrutinized as per the criterion given in the advertisement. 65 applicants were eligible & were called for written examination. 61 Candidate appeared for written test on 25.05.2024. 28 candidates were shortlisted based on written examination & were called for the clinical skill test & interview.
The clinical skill test and interviews were conducted on 27
th
and 28
th
May 2024 & all attended the same.  Following candidates were selected by the competent authorities based on the written test, skill test and interview. The list of the selected candidates as per category is as follows.
